expected_revision.note: Everything else should carry forward from the ledger without being re-cleared. STATE FARM is the case worth watching: the name is unchanged, so a diff on names alone would carry its old verdict forward, but the new scene puts a named adjuster approving eleven fraudulent files under a STATE FARM banner. Its exposure went up, and a clearance system that misses that has silently passed a defamation risk through a revision.
